review_kind: Static read-only acceptance audit; no execution
dynamic_imports: Each test module imports only its local verify.py; both implementations use standard-library exact integer/rational arithmetic. No optional package dependency.

acceptance_hazards.test_writes: One source-corruption rejection case writes only inside TemporaryDirectory.
acceptance_hazards.cli_write_flags: verify.py writes retained reports/certificates only with explicit --write-report or --write-certificate; ordinary acceptance compares retained bytes.

excluded_historical_tools: pruned/validate.py and rectangular/validate.py invoke historical Git/receipt subprocesses and write receipts under main guards. Optional discovery/explore.py and split_auxiliary.py run bounded randomized/modular searches and write results only under main guards; acceptance reads retained dimension_profiles.json but never imports or invokes discovery.
scope_checks: All13,845 source triples and signed grades are checked exactly.
The all-n polynomial is independently compared with complete direct grids at n=2,3.
Rejection tests cover external byte corruption, erased scalar grades, removed correction subsets, understated budgets and incomplete shape certificates.
Full-grid d<=32 and d=33 non-exclusion control, q>=3 full-target rigidity and restricted-target/separated-row counter-controls are retained.
